template.name: DiscordSRV
template.description: Connect your Minecraft server chat, console, and status events with Discord. Installs DiscordSRV 1.30.5 and configures the bot token and channels.

variables.label: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Token for your Discord bot from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.label: Chat Channel ID
variables.description: Discord text channel ID linked to in-game global chat.

variables.label: Console Channel ID
variables.description: Optional Discord channel ID for live console output. Leave blank to disable.

variables.label: Discord Invite Link
variables.description: Optional invite URL shown to players when they run /discord.

steps.name: Write DiscordSRV configuration
